newsitem.title: USA: Primark sees Q1 shr lower than estimate.
newsitem.headline: Primark sees Q1 shr lower than estimate.

text.p: Information technology company Primark Corp said Thursday it expected earnings per share for its first quarter to be lower than Street estimates.
Primark said earnings would likely be about $0.10 lower than the $0.25 consensus estimate reported by I/B/E/S for earnings per share from continuing operations and before extraordinary items.
"It is not anticipated that this first quarter shortfall will be recovered over the balance of the year," it said.
First Call's consensus among industry analysts also had a $0.25-a-share forecast for the company.
Primark blamed foreign currency movements and continuing operating problems at Groupe DAFSA, its Paris-based information business, and TIMCO, its aircraft maintenance subsidiary.
